name: secure-e2e-chat
description: A lightweight browser-based end-to-end encrypted chat site.

scripts.lint: node --check config.js && node --check utils/http.js && node --check utils/data.js && node --check utils/normalize.js && node --check server.js && node --check middleware/access-log.js && node --check services/access-log-store.js && node --check scripts/build-assets.js && node --check scripts/verify-build.js && node --check scripts/write-build-manifest.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/admin.js && node --check public/admin-user.js && node --check tests/e2e.test.js

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run verify:build
